verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains only generic API/webhook references (e.g., an 'Application deleted' webhook trigger) but no documentation of configurable data retention policies, GDPR/right-to-be-forgotten deletion workflows, or data-lifecycle controls that an AI-native user could invoke. Missing for 10: explicit retention policy settings, self-service deletion/erasure API or UI, documented compliance controls (GDPR/CCPA), and any independent verification of these mechanisms.
